finalText:
Migrated the last 12 files off `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — cohort, returnService, shipment, refund, couponService, macroAdmin, sla, variantAdmin, supplier, teamService, apiKeyAdmin, and session.

Left `cache.query` and the vendored `legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched, since those aren't part of the switch. `verify.js` confirms it: every call site moved and nothing else did.
